purpose: An explicitly versioned revision of the frozen VALIDATION protocol that separates the exact empirical support layer from the exact-context estimate admissibility layer, without changing any threshold, comparator, gate or support rule.

statuses.outcome_rule: ADMIT_CANDIDATE only when every frozen gate passes; otherwise RETAIN_ACTIVE_REFERENCE
statuses.unresolved_nodes_do_not_fail_the_run: a node that stays EXACT_UNRESOLVED is reported as such; it is neither an admission nor a defect, and it never blocks the outcome decision

values.condition: the requested fine key meets both 20/20 thresholds and the reported estimate uses pooling.level == L0_EXACT_KEY
values.consumed_as: exact empirical support for the exact requested context
values.interpretation: exact empirical support for this exact context

values.condition: the requested fine key is below threshold but a declared parent level meets both 20/20 thresholds; pooling.level and pooling.source_key are reported
values.consumed_as: an estimate for the exact requested context with its declared pooling level, never as exact support
values.interpretation: an estimate for the exact requested context whose parameters were shrunk toward a declared parent; it is never an exact-support claim

values.condition: no level meets both thresholds, or the raise sizing for the branch is unresolved, or the requested key violates the support isolation rule
values.consumed_as: nothing; the node and its descendants stay unresolved
values.interpretation: no answer is emitted; the context and its descendants stay unresolved

thresholds.exact_claim_requires: L0_EXACT_KEY meeting both the 20-observation and 20-distinct-hands thresholds

v1_custody.verification: every recorded sha256 is recomputed from the persisted bytes at authoring time and again by --check; any drift is a hard failure, and the frozen v1 generator digest is re-verified so the v1 pre-registration cannot be silently edited

what_changed: the protocol now names two layers explicitly: (a) exact empirical support and (b) exact-context estimate admissibility
the exact-context estimate layer states its mandatory effective-sample-size, uncertainty and pooling-provenance reporting obligations
the admissibility gates of layer (b) are named explicitly as calibration, pooling and sizing obligations, carried over from the frozen v1 gates
the rule for consuming an admissible node answer is stated once, per status
what_did_not_change: the 20 marginal observations / 20 distinct hands thresholds
the EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG label and its L0_EXACT_KEY-only condition
the SUPPORT_ISOLATION_NO_KEY_BORROWS_SUPPORT rule and support.source_key == requested_key
the three comparators, the admission gates and the outcome rule
the frozen VALIDATION result and the terminal decision
